# BergAgents Cheat Sheet

A reference page for the most-used commands, endpoints, environment keys,
plugin identity, and data locations.
Pairs with
[Configuration](CONFIGURATION.qmd), [Tools](TOOLS.qmd),
[Memory & Compaction](MEMORY.qmd), and the
[Plugin UI](plugins/PLUGIN-UI.qmd) contract.

## Slash commands (shared by TUI / web)

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/help` | List all commands |
| `/agents` | Names/ids of registered agents plus per-agent settings |
| `/models` | Loaded models and current selection |
| `/tools` | Available tool names (risk banners) |
| `/stats` | Learning/tool usage stats |
| `/health` | System health check (web only; listed in TUI parity) |
| `/history` | Task transcript (web/KTUI) |
| `/memory` | Memory information (web version) |
| `/context` | Current context dump (web version) |
| `/plugins` | Loaded plugin inventory (web) |
| `/skills` | Skill inventory (web) |
| `/mcps` | MCP server status (web) |
| `/settings` | Settings snapshot (web) |
| `/harness <task>` or `/task <task>` | Run a task through the harness |
<|end|> `/clear` | Clear the session's end context |

TUI-only commands accept free text; anything non-slash becomes a
generic task.
Web supports the same list via the slash picker.

## CLI entry points

```bash
python -m berg_agents --tui               # interactive TUI
python -m berg_agents --web               # default host 0.0.0.0, port 8001
python -m berg_agents --web --port 8123   # pick a port
python -m berg_agents --web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
```

There are no additional flags wired to those settings (e.g.
`--verbose`).
Exit the TUI with Ctrl-D or `/clear` plus empty run,
both standard.

## REST API endpoints

You can reach all endpoints from a `curl`/browser at the same origin as
the web UI.

### Providers and agents

- `GET  /api/providers` --- provider configs
- `GET  /api/providers/active` --- active model selection
- `POST /api/providers/active` --- set active model
- `GET  /api/agents` --- agent inventory
- `GET  /api/agents/{name}` --- agent detail

### Harness / chat loops

- `POST /api/tool/execute` --- synchronous tool execution
- `POST /api/chat/stream` --- start a streamed chat run
- `GET  /api/harness` should not be used from docs check `/threads` path
  of current API
- `GET  /api/learning-stats` --- learning outcome stats
- `GET  /api/threads` --- list threads
- `POST /api/threads` --- create thread
- `POST /api/threads/{id}/cancel` --- cancel running
- `POST /api/threads/{id}/export` --- export transcript
- `POST /api/harness/{thread_id}/stream` --- agent stream
- `GET  /api/harness/{thread_id}/events` --- JSON events stream
- `POST /api/harness/{thread_id}/respond` --- HITL response

### Plugins and sessions

- `GET  /api/plugins` --- plugin inventory + capabilities + UI
- `POST /api/plugins/{plugin_id}/tools/{tool_name}` --- generic dispatch (request body JSON or string args mapped to file_path)
- `POST /api/plugins/{plugin_id}/enable`
- `POST /api/plugins/{plugin_id}/disable`
- `GET  /api/sessions`
- `GET  /api/sessions/current`
- `POST /api/sessions/current`
- `POST /api/sessions` --- create session
- `GET  /api/sessions/{id}` --- retrieve
- `PATCH /api/sessions/{id}` --- rename/update
- `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}`

### General

- `GET  /api/tools` --- tool names and risk classes
- `GET  /api/context` --- resolved context sources + config dir
- `GET  /api/history` (History page serves it) --- page by page search
- `GET  /api/plugins/{id}/...` mostly metadata
- `GET  /berg-plugins/<plugin>/ui/dist/<surface>.js` --- plugin bundle
- `GET  /history` --- search/restore history UI

For authoritative, generated docs: open the served FastAPI open API at
`/docs` once the server is running.

## Environment and config keys

### Config-level (JSONC)

- `BERG_AGENT_PROVIDER`: `ollama`, `openai`, `unsloth`, etc.
- `BERG_AGENT_BASE_URL`: optional
- `BERG_AGENT_MODEL`: optional override
- `BERG_AGENT_TEMPERATURE`
- `BERG_AGENT_STREAM` (`true`)
- `BERG_AGENT_VERBOSE` / `BERG_AGENT_LOG_LEVEL`
- `BERG_AGENT_ROOT_DIR`: explicit workspace path
- `BERG_AGENT_MCP_SERVERS`: MCP JSON file path
- `BERG_AGENT_SKILLS`: JSON array of skill directories (`[[path, label]]`)
- `BERG_AGENT_PLUGINS`: JSON array of plugin dirs (`./.shared_todo/`)
- `BERG_AGENT_WEB_SEARCH_BACKENDS`: list of backends (`ollama`, `duckduckgo`, `direct`)
- `BERG_AGENT_MEMORY`: JSON array of always-loaded AGENTS memory files
- `BERG_AGENT_TODOS_ENABLED`: enable model's write-todos tool
- `BERG_AGENT_SUMMARIZATION_TRIGGER`
- `BERG_AGENT_SUMMARIZATION_KEEP`
- `providers`, `defaultModel`, `harness`, `model_routing`, `hitl_rules`,
  `agents`: provider + routing config (preferred modern form)
- `CONTEXT7_API_KEY`
- `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` (if you wire github mcp)

### Environment variables

- `BERG_AGENTS_CONFIG_DIR`: highest config path precedence
- `BERG_AGENT_*`: forward each setting directly via environment
- `BERG_AGENT_OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`/`BERG_AGENT_OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL`
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `COHERE_API_KEY`,
  `UNSLOTH_API_KEY`, `OLLAMA_API_KEY`, `CONTEXT7_API_KEY`
- `BERG_AGENT_OLLAMA_HOST`, `_PORT`, `_SCHEME`

Prefix alignment: JSONC keys using dots/sections are mirrored by
`BERG_AGENT_*` family env keys; use env values with `${env:...}` or direct.

### Plugin per-plugin settings

Plugin config lives at `{config}/.{slug}/config.yaml` (e.g.
`{config}/.shared_todo/config.yaml`) and uses:

- `{slug}` derived from plugin id (always lowercase, stripped `--todo`)
- `load_config(manifest, defaults)` with schema defaults
- Writes persist when adapters record identity (`persist=True`)

## Plugin identities

  | Plugin id                 | Package                    | Install                        | Tools                     | UI                  |
  | ---                       | ---                        | ---                            | ---                       | ---                 |
  | `berg-plugin-shared-todo` | `berg_plugins/shared-todo` | `build:ui`                     | 10 (incl. helper)         | side panel `        |
  | label \"📋 Todos\"`       |                            |                                |                           |                     |
  | `berg-plugin-skill-*`     | skills via config paths    | pre-built (no personal bundle) | deferred                  | none                |
  | `berg-plugin-mcp-*`       | config servers (fronted)   | none                           | contributed by mcp server | none (status badge) |

- Tools require a tools chain (registry: can disable via backend)
- Plugin `ui.entry` URL is served at
  `/berg-plugins/<plugin-dir>/...` with no cache.

## File/data layout (do not move lightly)

```
.berg-agents/                     # technology solution root
  bergagents.jsonc                 # typed settings + providers
  profiles.yaml                    # prompt suffix/tool tuning per model
  mcp.json                        # external servers
  active_session                  # tracked pointer for new windows
  chat_sessions.db                 # sessions + full conversation JSON
  runs.db                         # step persistence + search
  plugins/                        # per-plugin config (persisted)
  .shared_todo/                    # shared-todo identity/config
  memory/                         # memory runtime
      MEMORY.md                    # auto-injected notebook
      (topic files)               # per-feature memory
  (legacy nested memories)        # leave untouched unless you know them
sharedtodos/                      # user todo (Markdown-level)
berg_plugins/<plugin>/            # plugin sources + bundles
```

Do NOT exit or rename any of these without considering consequences:
- Debug rollbacks require the db not page-level deletion.
Clean
up only from code that understands each schema.
- Uninstalling plugins does not touch their `{config}/.{plugin}` folder;
manual archive/restore it yourself.

## Build/dev quick keys

- `npm run build` (web app) writes static export FastAPI serves.
- `npm run build:ui` (plugin package) writes `ui/dist/<surface>.js`.
- `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` for TypeScript checks.
- `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`
- `pytest -q` for offline tests only (no provider).
  Slow test suite by
  marker opt-in.

## One-line verification

```bash
# plugin visibility
curl -s http://localhost:8001/api/plugins | head
curl -s http://localhost:8001/berg-plugins/shared-todo/ui/dist/todo-surface.js | head
curl -s http://localhost:8001/api/tools
```

All generated via local codebase + notes; if something changes,
consult `notes/recovery_plugin_plan.md` for contract details.
